rationale: Thomas, as the most senior justice in the majority, would likely assign the opinion to himself given his strong originalist Bill of Attainder analysis or to Barrett given her careful synthesis of both grounds; the ideologically diverse majority (Thomas, Sotomayor, Gorsuch, Barrett, Jackson) creates strong incentives for separate concurrences emphasizing different rationales. The four dissenters, particularly Roberts and Alito, are likely to write separately given their strong institutional and doctrinal objections.
